summary_for_children: An-Naba' means The Great News. It asks people to look at signs: the earth, mountains, sleep, night and day, the sun, rain and gardens.
world_title: The Earth as a Resting Place
environment_concept: A walk through the signs listed in the surah: the earth a resting place, mountains like stakes, sleep, night as clothing, a burning lamp and rain bringing gardens.
architecture_and_scenery: Flat plains with tent-peg mountains, a night camp, a bright sun, rain clouds, gardens.

activities.name: Sign checklist
activities.description: Collect each sign as the ayahs list it.
